newsitem.title: USA: Kids Mart files for chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Kids Mart files for chapter 11.

text.p: Kids Mart Inc and two subsidiaries filed for Chapter 11 protection on Friday in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware.

In court papers, the company listed assets of $13.9 million and liabilities of $29.8 million of which $22.4 million is unsecured. Most of the debt is in trade debt, real estate leases and promissory notes.
Kids Mart operates 144 children's apparel stores generally located in strip shopping centers.
According to court papers, at least 20 percent of the voting securities of Kids Mart are owned by Cede & Co, and there are 88 holders of 5.4 million shares of common stock.

In September Kids Mart said it closed 97 stores, which at that time left 182 operating in 18 states. Kids Mart Chairman Bernie Tessler said that the company had suffered substantial losses and cash flow constraints in the previous 12 months and hoped that the store closings would "improve the company's operations."
Kids Mart and the two subsidiaries, Holtzman's Little Folk Shop Inc and LFS Acquisition Corp, are based in City of Industry, Calif.
